Geographies Served Programs Dance Movement Therapy Sessions District Kolkata State West Bengal District Kolkata States West Bengal Kolkata Sanved conducts Dance Movement Therapy (DMT) sessions in collaboration with Government departments, NGOs, and community-based organizations. These sessions, held in childcare institutions and specially designed for the Indian context, aim to empower marginalized communities, including survivors of gender-based violence and at-risk youth. The unique Sampoornata model not only heals but also encourages participants to become DMT practitioners, fostering a cycle of transformation within society. Sessions include both regular group sessions lasting 2 to 3 hours weekly and monthly workshops, with a focus on empowering individuals to become agents of change. Dance Movement Therapy Leadership Development (DMTLD) Programme District Kolkata State West Bengal District Kolkata States West Bengal Kolkata Sanved's Dance Movement Therapy Leadership Development (DMTLD) programme empowers marginalized individuals to become certified Therapeutic Movement Practitioners, fostering their journey towards becoming DMT Practitioners themselves. Through experiential DMT sessions, theoretical classes on mental health and DMT, and practical internships, participants gain valuable skills and an alternative employment avenue. More than just livelihood creation, DMTLD embodies Kolkata Sanved's belief that survivors possess the potential to emerge as leaders and advocates for transformative DMT practices within their communities.
